title: Jefferies technical analyst finds an encouraging development in Thursday rebound, setting stage for rally into year-end
summary: Lower rates are generating interest in non-tech equities, with a Jefferies technical analyst identifying Thursday's market rebound as an encouraging sign setting the stage for potential year-end rally.
content: Lower rates are starting to generate a bid for the rest of the market, underneath the top handful of tech stocks.

zh.title: 杰富瑞技术分析师发现周四反弹中的积极迹象，为年末反弹奠定基础
zh.summary: 较低的利率正在激发对非科技股的兴趣，杰富瑞技术分析师将周四的市场反弹视为积极信号，为潜在的年末反弹奠定基础。

title: U.S. Starlink curbs embolden Russia to intensify attacks on Ukraine, minister tells CNBC
summary: Starlink service limitations in Ukraine are hampering military operations and emboldening Russian attacks. Ukraine is seeking additional winter energy and air-defense support as Russian strikes intensify.
content: Ukraine is seeking winter energy and air-defense support as Russian strikes intensify and Starlink limits disrupt military operations.

zh.title: 美国Starlink限制措施助长俄罗斯加剧对乌克兰的攻击，部长对CNBC表示
zh.summary: 乌克兰的Starlink服务限制正在阻碍军事行动并鼓励俄罗斯攻击。乌克兰正在寻求额外的冬季能源和防空支持，因为俄罗斯的袭击正在加剧。

title: The best of the AI trade could be behind us. Here’s how to prepare, according to Barclays.
summary: Barclays warns that peak gains from the artificial intelligence investment boom may have already passed. The bank recommends holding established Big Tech stocks while awaiting earnings, but favors companies with strong underlying business models.
content: The London-based bank recommends holding on to Big Tech stocks ahead of their earnings, but has a preference for companies with strong business models.

zh.title: 人工智能交易的最佳时期可能已经过去。据巴克莱称，以下是如何做好准备
zh.summary: 巴克莱警告说，人工智能投资热潮的最高收益可能已经过去。该银行建议在等待业绩期间继续持有老牌大型科技股，但更看好具有强大基础商业模式的公司。

title: Banks expect to be hit with higher taxes in Budget
summary: Banking executives anticipate the upcoming government Budget will include higher tax measures targeting their sector. Senior leaders have signaled they expect to be among the Chancellor's tax-raising priorities.
content: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

zh.title: 银行预计在预算案中面临更高税收
zh.summary: 银行高管预计即将出台的政府预算案将包含针对该行业的更高税收措施。资深领导人表示，他们预计将成为财政大臣提高税收的优先目标之一。

title: Trump says he won't use nuclear weapons or send ground troops to Iran
summary: Trump ruled out using nuclear weapons against Iran or deploying ground troops to the country. The statement comes as the U.S. reportedly explores alternative military strike options.
content: Trump said he would not use nuclear weapons against Iran or send ground troops as the U.S. reportedly weighs new strike options.

zh.title: 特朗普表示不会对伊朗使用核武器或派遣地面部队
zh.summary: 特朗普排除了对伊朗使用核武器或向该国部署地面部队的可能性。此声明是在美国据称正在探索替代军事打击选项之际发布的。

title: Here are the key things Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said — and didn’t say — while Americans were sleeping Thursday night
summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declined to signal the direction of future interest rates ahead of the central bank's rate-setting meeting in two weeks. His cautious approach continues his pattern of leaving markets guessing about policy intentions.
content: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh had the opportunity Thursday night to shape expectations before the central bank’s interest-rate-setting meeting in two weeks — and in keeping with his practice of leaving markets guessing, he chose not to.

zh.title: 美联储主席沃什周四夜间的言论要点——及其未提及的内容
zh.summary: 美联储主席凯文·沃什在中央银行两周后的决议会议前拒绝透露未来利率方向。他谨慎的态度延续了他让市场猜测政策意向的既有模式。

title: ‘It’s a wait-and-see situation’: I’m 63 and diagnosed with lymphoma. Should I take my Social Security next year?
summary: A 63-year-old facing a lymphoma diagnosis weighs the financial strategy of claiming Social Security early versus continuing to work. The individual plans to invest any Social Security benefits received while still earning income if able.
content: “My plan is to continue working as long as I’m able to do so and invest my Social Security benefits while I’m still earning a paycheck.”

zh.title: "这是一个等待和观察的情况"：我63岁，被诊断出淋巴瘤。我明年应该领取社会保障金吗？
zh.summary: 一位63岁的人面临淋巴瘤诊断，在提早申领社会保障金与继续工作的财务策略之间进行权衡。这个人计划在仍然有能力工作的情况下投资所获得的任何社会保障金。

title: The pull of Nashville: A dozen celebrities who have moved to Tennessee, and why
summary: Nashville has expanded beyond its traditional country and R&B music base to attract celebrities from diverse industries. The trend reflects the city's growing appeal as a lifestyle destination for high-profile figures.
content: Nashville has long been home to many big names in R&B and country music, but over the last few years, celebrities from a variety of industries have flocked to the Music City.

zh.title: 纳什维尔的吸引力：十多位搬到田纳西州的名人及其原因
zh.summary: 纳什维尔已超越其传统的乡村和节奏蓝调音乐基础，吸引来自不同行业的名人。这一趋势反映了该城市作为高知名度人士生活方式目的地不断增长的吸引力。

title: SpaceX policy manager set to testify as part of NYC Council AI safety investigation
summary: SpaceX will send its head of AI government affairs, Gabriela Castillo Madrid, to testify before the New York City Council. The appearance is part of the council's investigation into artificial intelligence safety measures.
content: SpaceX is sending its head of global government affairs for AI, Gabriela Castillo Madrid, to testify before the New York City Council.

zh.title: SpaceX政策经理准备就纽约市议会AI安全调查作证
zh.summary: SpaceX将派其人工智能政府事务负责人加布里埃拉·卡斯蒂略·马德里在纽约市议会作证。这次出席是市议会人工智能安全措施调查的一部分。

title: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, praises recent global tightening with 'no free riders'
summary: Fed Chair Warsh refrained from signaling additional interest rate hikes this month while praising coordinated central bank tightening globally. He emphasized recent global monetary policy actions show coordinated efforts to combat inflation with no country acting as a free rider.
content: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.

zh.title: 美联储沃什拒绝发出加息信号，赞扬最近全球货币收紧"没有免费乘车者"
zh.summary: 美联储主席沃什本月拒绝发出额外加息信号，同时赞扬全球协调央行收紧。他强调最近的全球货币政策行动显示协调努力应对通胀，没有国家充当免费乘车者。

title: Marco Rubio to visit Indian billionaire Ambani's refinery in Gujarat as U.S. diesel prices surge
summary: U.S. official Marco Rubio is visiting the massive Reliance refinery in Gujarat as U.S. diesel prices surge. Reliance's refinery operations and ability to supply diesel, combined with its Venezuelan oil purchases and U.S. refinery investments, make the facility strategically significant.
content: Not only is Ambani's Reliance investing in a U.S. refinery and buying Venezuelan oil, but its strong ability to supply diesel has put Jamnagar on the map during Rubio's visit.

zh.title: 随着美国柴油价格飙升，马可·鲁比奥将访问印度亿万富翁安巴尼在古吉拉特邦的炼油厂
zh.summary: 美国官员马可·鲁比奥访问信实公司在古吉拉特邦的大型炼油厂，此时美国柴油价格飙升。信实公司的炼油厂运营和供应柴油的能力，加上其委内瑞拉石油采购和美国炼油厂投资，使该设施具有战略意义。

title: Fuel costs squeezing margins for some businesses
summary: Diesel prices have recently exceeded £2 per liter, pressuring business margins across multiple sectors. Concerns remain that the government's fuel duty freeze will provide insufficient relief to affected businesses.
content: Diesel recently topped £2 per litre and there is concern that a duty freeze will not go far enough.

zh.title: 燃料成本压低企业利润
zh.summary: 柴油价格最近超过每升2英镑，对多个部门的企业利润造成压力。人们担忧政府的燃油税冻结将无法为受影响的企业提供足够救济。

title: 'TV and cheap booze' blamed for landlord quitting
summary: Lincolnshire has lost 27% of its pubs and bars since 2009, with cheap supermarket alcohol identified as a contributing factor. Advocates are calling on the government to implement measures restricting discount alcohol sales.
content: Lincolnshire has lost 27% of its pubs and bars since 2009 and some are calling on the government to act against cheap supermarket booze.

zh.title: 电视和廉价酒精被指责是酒吧老板离职的原因
zh.summary: 自2009年以来，林肯郡失去了27%的酒吧和酒馆，廉价超市酒精被认为是一个贡献因素。倡导者呼吁政府实施限制折扣酒精销售的措施。

title: Ship attack reports near Hormuz reach record high as oil exports slow
summary: Maritime attacks near the Strait of Hormuz have reached record levels, with 12 vessels struck within a single week according to BBC analysis. The surge in attacks is coinciding with slowed oil export activity in the region.
content: BBC Verify analysis of data from a UK maritime agency shows 12 vessels were struck in a week.

zh.title: 荷尔木兹海峡附近船舶袭击报告达到创纪录高位，石油出口放缓
zh.summary: 根据英国广播公司分析，霍尔木兹海峡附近的海上袭击达到创纪录水平，一周内有12艘船只遭到袭击。袭击次数的激增与该地区石油出口活动放缓相吻合。

title: The IPO drought is driving private equity-owned companies to the debt market to pay investors
summary: Private equity firms are increasingly using debt-funded dividend recapitalizations to distribute cash to investors as exit opportunities decline. The shift reflects a prolonged slowdown in initial public offerings limiting traditional exit channels.
content: Private equity firms are increasingly using debt-funded dividend recaps to return cash to investors as exits remain subdued.

zh.title: IPO融资困难促使私募股权公司向债券市场融资支付投资者
zh.summary: 随着退出机会减少，私募股权公司越来越多地使用债务融资的股息资本重组向投资者分配现金。这一转变反映了首次公开募股长期放缓，限制了传统退出渠道。

title: S&P 500 futures are little changed as index heads for losing week: Live updates
summary: Major U.S. stock indices are trading flat as markets approach the end of a losing week, despite gains on Thursday. The momentum shift signals investor uncertainty and profit-taking concerns heading into the weekend.
content: The three major averages are coming off of a winning session on Thursday.

zh.title: 标普500指数期货小幅波动，指数走向下跌周：实时更新
zh.summary: 美国主要股票指数交投平稳，尽管周四有所上涨，但市场接近下跌周的尾声。动能转变表明投资者不确定性和获利回吐担忧在周末前加剧。

title: Tesla finally delivers on its promise to create a flying car
summary: Tesla demonstrated a levitating Roadster sports car, showcasing technological capability despite acknowledged lack of commercial viability. The demonstration serves as a public statement of engineering prowess in the competitive automotive industry.
content: Tesla’s demonstration of a levitating Roadster sports car was “an engineering flex with no commercial value beyond embarrassing traditional car makers.”

zh.title: 特斯拉终于兑现承诺推出飞行汽车
zh.summary: 特斯拉展示了一辆悬浮Roadster跑车，展示了技术能力，尽管承认商业可行性不足。该演示是对竞争激烈的汽车行业工程实力的公开声明。

title: Russia returns to G20 table in Bangkok on U.S. invitation that angers Europe
summary: Russia rejoined G20 discussions in Bangkok following a U.S. invitation, creating diplomatic friction with European allies. The move raises questions about balancing U.S.-Russia engagement against Western unity on geopolitical issues.
content: Russia’s return to the G20 table has tested how far Washington’s outreach to Moscow will strain ties with European allies.

zh.title: 俄罗斯应美国邀请重返曼谷G20谈判桌，激怒欧洲
zh.summary: 俄罗斯应美国邀请重新加入曼谷G20讨论，与欧洲盟国造成外交摩擦。该举动引发了关于平衡美俄接触与西方地缘政治团结的问题。

title: Order to limit Starshield for Ukraine came from inside White House: Reuters reports
summary: The White House reportedly ordered restrictions on Starshield service for Ukraine, impacting critical drone operations and escalating tensions between Washington and Kyiv. The directive signals potential shifts in U.S. policy regarding military aid to Ukraine.
content: Officials say the White House ordered temporary limits on Ukraine’s Starshield service, affecting drone operations amid rising U.S.-Kyiv tensions.

zh.title: 白宫下令限制星盾对乌克兰的服务：路透社报道
zh.summary: 白宫据报下令限制星盾对乌克兰的服务，影响了关键的无人机作战，加剧了华盛顿和基辅之间的紧张关系。该指令预示了美国对乌克兰军事援助政策的潜在转变。

title: India's rupee forecast to weaken toward 100-per-dollar level even as RBI pushes back
summary: India's rupee is forecast to weaken to 100 per dollar despite Reserve Bank intervention that recently strengthened the currency from 96.79 levels. The projection reflects ongoing capital outflow pressures affecting emerging market currencies.
content: The RBI's latest moves have helped the rupee recover from 96.79 rupees per dollar to the 95-level over recent days.

zh.title: 尽管印度央行力挽狂澜，印度卢比仍预期走弱至每美元100卢比水平
zh.summary: 尽管印度储备银行近期的干预措施已将卢比从96.79水平升值，但印度卢比仍预期走弱至每美元100卢比。这一预测反映了影响新兴市场货币的持续资本外流压力。

title: Gasping for clean air: Singapore battles relentless haze as Prime Minister Wong warns of action
summary: Singapore faces severe air pollution from persistent haze disrupting businesses and daily life, prompting government intervention and protective measures. The environmental crisis highlights regional challenges affecting economic activity and public health.
content: Singapore continues to grapple with severe haze that is disrupting daily life and businesses, as authorities roll out protective measures — and issue warnings.

zh.title: 渴望清洁空气：新加坡对抗持续雾霾，总理黄循财警告将采取行动
zh.summary: 新加坡面临持续雾霾造成的严重空气污染，扰乱了商业和日常生活，促使政府进行干预和采取保护措施。这一环境危机凸显了影响经济活动和公共卫生的区域性挑战。
